name: Ferienhaus Hubmann
beschreibung:
Perched on the sun-kissed plateau of Schwoich, Ferienhaus Hubmann welcomes visitors with charming Tyrolean hospitality. Its well-kept rooms and apartments provide modern comforts for couples and families alike.

Picturesque hiking paths, mountain bike trails, and outing destinations like the Kaiser mountains, Lake Banndlsee, and Kufstein surround the property.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Hubmann in Schwoich offers countryside relaxation and comfortable holiday lodging in Kufsteinerland.
